about.heading: The AI automation partner for growing businesses. AI systems that bring in more leads and take the repetitive work off your team.

pre.label: (Pre)
pre.text: Leads slip through the cracks, replies take hours, and your team loses days to copy-pasting, data entry and chasing follow-ups.

post.label: (+Post)
post.text: We build AI systems that respond to every lead in minutes, qualify them and handle the repetitive tasks in the background, reliably, day and night.

founder.label: (You'll work with)
founder.intro: I'm Márton, the founder of Black Systems. I work with every client directly, from mapping how your business runs to launching the system and keeping it running, so you always know what's being built and why.
more: Before Black Systems, I spent seven years in software development, most of them in corporate banking, where systems have to be secure, precise and never fail. I bring that same standard to every automation I build.

I started Black Systems to create high added value where it's needed most. I believe most everyday work can be far simpler than it is today: every workflow that runs on its own gives time back to your team and makes the whole business more productive.

services.heading: Process-driven agency delivering custom-built automation - we map how your business really runs, then design, integrate and maintain systems that fit it exactly.

cards.heading: Instant follow-up
cards.body: Every inquiry from your website, forms, email or ads gets an answer within minutes, day or night. The system qualifies the lead, answers common questions and books the call straight into your calendar.
cards.imageAlt: A woman running ahead of a group of runners on a desert road at sunrise

cards.heading: Hands-off operations
cards.body: Copy-pasting, data entry, CRM updates, follow-up emails and reports run automatically between your tools, so your team spends its time on clients, not admin.
cards.imageAlt: A woman painting the Mona Lisa by hand next to a factory production line

cards.heading: Built around your process
cards.body: We map how your business actually runs, find where time and leads are lost, and build tailored automations for everything in between, tested, integrated and supported after launch.
cards.imageAlt: A craftsman hand-finishing a wooden boat on a seaside cliff

lead-machine.title: The Lead Machine
lead-machine.description: Turning every property inquiry into a qualified sales opportunity.
lead-machine.intro: An automated lead engine that captures every inquiry, qualifies intent, responds instantly, and routes sales-ready prospects directly into the CRM.
lead-machine.research: We mapped the journey from first inquiry to booked call, identifying slow response times, manual qualification, fragmented lead sources, and missed follow-ups.
lead-machine.solution: Every lead is captured and enriched automatically. AI qualifies intent, structures key details, updates the CRM, triggers a tailored response, and routes qualified prospects to sales.

ai-recruiter.title: The AI Recruiter
ai-recruiter.description: Turning hundreds of applications into a structured shortlist.
ai-recruiter.intro: An AI-powered screening workflow that reads incoming applications, extracts candidate data, evaluates job fit, and gives recruiters a prioritized shortlist.
ai-recruiter.research: We mapped the screening process and found recruiters repeatedly reading CVs, transferring candidate data, checking requirements, and manually building shortlists.
ai-recruiter.solution: AI extracts and structures every application, evaluates candidates against defined criteria, flags missing requirements, scores fit, and syncs the results directly with the ATS.

24-7-front-desk.title: The 24/7 Front Desk
24-7-front-desk.description: Guest inquiries answered and routed while the team sleeps.
24-7-front-desk.intro: An always-on AI front desk that handles routine guest questions, captures requests, schedules services, and escalates conversations that need a human.
24-7-front-desk.research: We analyzed repetitive guest communication across web and messaging channels, identifying recurring questions, delayed replies, booking friction, and unnecessary staff workload.
24-7-front-desk.solution: The AI responds instantly using approved business information, handles common requests, collects missing details, schedules where possible, and hands complex conversations to staff.

invisible-back-office.title: The Invisible Back Office
invisible-back-office.description: The repetitive admin work happens without anyone touching it.
invisible-back-office.intro: A connected operations workflow that processes documents, moves data between systems, updates records, sends follow-ups, and keeps reporting current automatically.
invisible-back-office.research: We mapped recurring administrative work across email, documents, CRM and internal tools, exposing duplicate entry, copy-pasting, inconsistent records, and manual reporting.
invisible-back-office.solution: Documents and messages are processed automatically, key data is validated and structured, systems stay synchronized, and exceptions are routed to people only when judgment is required.

items.question: How quickly will my first automation be live?
items.answer: Usually within weeks, not months. A free call maps where time and leads get lost, then we launch the automation with the biggest impact first and build from there.

items.question: Do I need to change the tools I already use?
items.answer: Not unless you want to. We connect the tools you already use, like your CRM, applicant tracking system, email or booking tools, so data flows between them automatically. If a new tool would fit better, we'll suggest it, but it's always optional. Anything new comes with team training and detailed notes.

items.question: Is my data and my customers' data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Security is built in from the start: each automation only accesses the data it needs, and you always know what's processed, where it's stored and who can see it. Nothing runs without your knowledge.

items.question: What happens if something breaks or my process changes?
items.answer: I don't hand over a system and disappear. Every automation is monitored after launch and adjusted as your business changes, whether that's a new lead source, a new tool or a new step in your process.

items.question: Will AI replace my team?
items.answer: No, it takes the repetitive work off their plate. Routine inquiries, data entry and follow-ups run automatically, and anything that needs judgment goes to a person, so your team can focus on clients.

legal.heading: Legal information
legal.intro: Our company details, what to expect when working with us, and how we handle personal data, all in one place.

items.label: (Free consultation)
items.text: The first consultation is free and comes with no obligation. We look at how your business runs and where automation would help most.

items.label: (Written proposal)
items.text: Before any work starts, you get a written proposal with the scope, the price and the timeline. Nothing is billed without your approval.

items.label: (Confidentiality)
items.text: Everything you share about your business is treated as confidential. On request, we sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) before the first detailed conversation.

items.label: (Access & security)
items.text: Automations only get access to the data they need, and you always know what runs where. You can revoke any access at any time.

items.label: (After launch)
items.text: Every automation is monitored after launch and adjusted when your process changes.

blocks.label: (Controller)
text: The data controller is {{company}} (see the company details above). Send any question about your personal data to {{email}}.

blocks.label: (Scope)
text: This notice explains what personal data we process when you visit this website, book a call, write to us or become a client, why we do it, and what your rights are.

blocks.label: (Website visits)
text: No tracking: this website uses no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. It only stores your language choice (English or Hungarian) in your browser, so the site opens in that language next time. This is not personal data, and you can remove it any time by clearing your browser data.

items.desc: Name, email address, the time you choose and anything you write in the booking form.
Arranging and holding the meeting you asked for.

Steps taken at your request (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)); for general questions, our legitimate interest in answering them (Art. 6(1)(f)).
Up to 1 year after our last contact, unless you become a client.

blocks.label: (Clients)
text: When an automation we build works with your customers' data, we process that data on your behalf, under a separate data processing agreement (GDPR Art. 28).

items.desc: Contact details of the client's representatives, contract and billing details, project correspondence.
Performing the contract and meeting our accounting obligations.
Performance of a contract (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)) and legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).
For the duration of the cooperation; contracts and invoices for 8 years, as required by Hungarian accounting law (Act C of 2000, Section 169).

blocks.label: (Processors)
text: These companies process data for us, only for the purposes above:
Cloudflare, Inc. (USA): website hosting and security.

Some of them are based outside the European Economic Area. These transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or on the standard contractual clauses adopted by the European Commission. We never sell your data or use it for advertising.

blocks.label: (Your rights)
text: You can ask for access to your personal data, its correction or deletion, the restriction of its processing, or a copy in a machine-readable format. You can object to processing based on our legitimate interest. Write to {{email}}; we answer within one month.
Providing your data is voluntary, but without it we cannot answer you or arrange a meeting. We do not use automated decision-making or profiling.

blocks.label: (Complaints)
text: If you believe we handle your data unlawfully, you can turn to the Hungarian data protection authority: Nemzeti Adatvédelmi és Információszabadság Hatóság (NAIH), 1055 Budapest, Falk Miksa utca 9-11.; postal address: 1363 Budapest, Pf. 9.; email: ugyfelszolgalat@naih.hu; website: https://naih.hu. You can also go to court; you may start the case before the court of your place of residence.

blocks.label: (Changes)
text: We update this notice when our services or the law change. The date at the top of this page always shows the latest version.
